dedupe_keys.name: hm land registry inspire index polygons freehold registered land england and wales

description: The INSPIRE Index Polygons show the indicative position and extent of registered freehold land parcels in England and Wales, published by HM Land Registry under the INSPIRE Directive. Each polygon has a Land Registry INSPIRE ID relating to a registered title, which can be used with the Find a Property service to obtain the title register and plan; one title can hold several polygons. Coverage: registered freehold land in England and Wales, a subset of the full Index Polygons database; leasehold and other tenures and unregistered land are not included, and polygons on a local authority boundary appear in both files. Access: one GML file per local authority, downloaded free from the Use land and property data service and refreshed monthly. Licence: Open Government Licence, with attribution to HM Land Registry and to Ordnance Survey for the underlying mapping. Caveats: the extent of land in a title can only be established from the title plan, not from these indicative polygons, and parcels do not map one to one onto buildings. Simulation uses are parcel units for building exposure, land assembly and adaptation option studies and linking footprints to property records. Related records: the England and Wales energy performance certificates and the Colouring Britain building attributes.
